description: Creates or overwrites a file at the specified path. Use this tool to create a new file or to replace the whole contents of an existing one. If the destination file already exists, you MUST first read it before writing, so a change you did not make is never overwritten. For a targeted change to an existing file, prefer StrReplace.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to write

contents.description: The contents to write to the file
